_why: Two transcript lines the pinned Claude Code host wrote into one crew member's session on this project's crew host, 2026-11-18, on 2.1.327 (martha#658): the delta that added the crew mod's 27 tools at the session's start, and the one that withdrew them 2 h 10 min later while the session worked on. The plugin API offers no call that withdraws a tool, so a withdrawal cannot be provoked on the recorded host; these were taken from a real loss. Kept as written, except: every name list is cut to the crew mod's own tools (the host listed 170 tools in the add), and each of those 27 names is replaced by the placeholder `mcp__a_mod__tool_01` … `mcp__a_mod__tool_27`, in the order the add listed them and the same in both lines (the real names are another tool's, which this repository does not carry), `surfacedDefinitions` is emptied (it carried other servers' tool descriptions), and only `type`, `timestamp` and `version` are kept of the line around the attachment (the rest names the session and its folder). Carried to 2.1.328 on 2026-11-19 (martha#807) by reading the binary, since a withdrawal still cannot be provoked and no session here had run 2.1.328: the functions that write the attachment (its `deferred_tools_delta` wrappers, the per-delta field writer and the delta builder) are the same code as 2.1.327's once minified names are masked. Two functions changed. The delta computation gains a single call whose result is passed to the filter choosing which tools count as surfaced. The cause the builder asks for each removed name is now classified against the tools the session shows (the full list unless a question's answer hides some) instead of every tool; the classifier reads that list only for a built-in tool, to tell replaced from withdrawn, and the recorded lines are an MCP server's tools, classified on the branch that does not read it; every field this reader takes is written by the same code, and the lines keep the `version` they were observed on. Carried to 2.1.329 on 2026-11-20 (martha#908) the same way, since no session here has run 2.1.329: the delta computation and the cause classifier that write every field this reader takes are the same code as 2.1.328's once minified names are masked, and the attachment is still the same three spreads of `{type:"deferred_tools_delta", ...}`. Two things around it changed, neither read here: whether `textAfterToolBlocks` is spread into the attachment is now decided by one host function, where a feature flag also gated it, and the per-delta builder no longer receives that flag as an argument. The lines keep the `version` they were observed on. A real 2.1.329 add and withdrawal replace them when a session records one.
